fusions.name: Cut from the Mesh
fusions.desc: A falling chop on a held target that deals 18 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Bladed Hem
fusions.desc: Whirls a mesh hemmed with edges around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 35% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Coat of Edges
fusions.desc: Wraps you in a mesh sewn with edges. For 9 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Keen Moment
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, your critical chance rises by 20% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
